# BodyLab.Beauty

> Body-contouring beauty studio in Riga, Latvia (Ķermeņa modelēšanas studija Rīgā). Online appointment booking, treatment info, and Arosha cosmetic products.

BodyLab.Beauty offers non-invasive body-contouring treatments in Riga:
- R-Sleek - body-contouring roller massage
- B-Flexy - vacuum-roller anti-cellulite massage
- EMS Zero - EMS muscle stimulation
- Presoterapija - lymphatic-drainage pressotherapy

Visitors can book an appointment directly on the website (real-time availability from Google Calendar), browse and order Arosha Aesthetic Science skincare/cosmetic products (creams and compression garments), buy a gift card, and find the studio's location and directions.
